references.source: Nordic Competition Authorities. 2016. "Competition in the Waste Management Sector: Preparing for a Circular Economy."
references.notes: Source notes that the definition of municipal waste in the Faeroe Islands differs from the standard definition, as other industrial wastes are processed in the same facilities, and a detailed breakdown is not available.
Value calculated based on total MSW generated per year, divided by 365 and population.

references.method: Complete ennumeration (data collected from facilities & aggregated)
references.notes: Waste treatment has been aggregated from two different sources, representing all waste entering the two treatment facilities in the Faeroe Islands, rather than just MSW. The source provides a detailed breakdown of waste treatment. The second  is an annual average. Passenger cars removed from total waste/recycling figure.
